grammar_focus: 复习 KS74-82 各时态综合(教材 L83 Key structures,方案B换情节包):一般现在(holds)、过去进行(were running/was watching)、一般过去(gathered/was)、过去完成被动(had been counted)、现在完成进行(have been waiting)、现在进行(is announcing/is planning)、现在完成(has won/have never felt)的综合运用辨析
scene: 每年,我们学校都会举办一次社长选举。今年,有三名学生参加竞选,全校都在关注。上周五,大家聚在礼堂里等着听结果。等我到的时候,选票已经清点完了。“同学们为这一刻等了整整一周,”老师说。此刻,校长正在宣布获胜者。米娅仅以五票之差赢了!她惊讶得一时说不出话来。“我从没这么高兴过,”她终于说道。现在,她正在筹划社团今年要办的所有趣味活动。

grammar_card.title: 复习 KS74-82 各时态综合
grammar_card.intro: 本课把学过的各种时态放在一个故事里综合辨析:①一般现在——每年都做的事(our school holds an election);②过去进行——过去某时正在做(three students were running / the school was watching);③一般过去——过去发生的事(everyone gathered);④过去完成(被动)——“过去的过去”(the votes had already been counted);⑤现在完成进行——一直做到现在(students have been waiting all week);⑥现在进行——此刻正在做(the principal is announcing / she is planning);⑦现在完成——影响到现在(Mia has won / I have never felt this happy)。

rows: Every year our school holds an election.
Three students were running; the school was watching.
一般过去 / 过去完成被动
Everyone gathered. / The votes had been counted.
The students have been waiting all week.
现在进行 / 现在完成
The principal is announcing… / Mia has won!

specialRules.rule: 美语里“校长”说 principal(英式 headmaster/head teacher)、“成绩、分数”说 grade(英式 mark);本课已按美语写。
同一个故事里各时态各司其职:每年惯例用一般现在,当时背景用过去进行,已完成影响现在用现在完成,此刻正做用现在进行。看时间标志选时态。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — Who won the club election, and by how much?
options: Mia won, by just five votes
No one won — it was a tie

passage: Every year, our school holds an election for club president. This year, three students were running, and the whole school was watching. Last Friday, everyone gathered in the hall to hear the results. By the time I arrived, the votes had already been counted. "The students have been waiting all week for this," the teacher said. Right now, the principal is announcing the winner. Mia has won by just five votes! She was so surprised that she couldn't speak for a moment. "I have never felt this happy," she finally said. Now she is planning all the fun events the club will hold this year.

grammar_points.name: 一般现在时(每年惯例:holds / takes place)
过去进行时(were running / was watching)
现在完成 / 现在完成进行(has won / have been waiting)
过去完成被动 / 现在进行(had been counted / is announcing)

stage5.stem: "Every year, our school ___ an election for club president."(每年惯例:一般现在)
stage5.stem_cn: 每年,我们学校都举办社长选举。

stage5.stem: "The winner usually ___ the club for one year."(通常做的事:一般现在)
stage5.stem_cn: 获胜者通常领导社团一年。

stage5.stem: "The election ___ place in the hall each spring."(每年春天惯例:一般现在)
stage5.stem_cn: 选举每年春天在礼堂举行。

stage5.stem: "This year, three students ___ for president."(当时正在竞选:过去进行)
stage5.stem_cn: 今年,有三名学生在竞选社长。

stage5.stem: "The whole school ___ the election closely."(当时正密切关注:过去进行)
stage5.stem_cn: 全校都在密切关注这次选举。

stage5.stem: "While the votes ___ counted, everyone waited nervously."(当时正被清点:过去进行被动)
stage5.stem_cn: 选票正在清点时,大家紧张地等着。

stage5.stem: "Last Friday, everyone ___ in the hall to hear the results."(gather 的过去式)
stage5.stem_cn: 上周五,大家聚在礼堂听结果。

stage5.stem: "Mia ___ so surprised that she couldn't speak."(be 的过去式)
stage5.stem_cn: 米娅惊讶得一时说不出话。

stage5.stem: "By the time I ___, the results were already in."(arrive 的过去式)
stage5.stem_cn: 我到的时候,结果已经出来了。

stage5.stem: "Mia ___ by just five votes!"(刚刚赢了、影响到现在:现在完成)
stage5.stem_cn: 米娅仅以五票之差赢了!

stage5.stem: "The students ___ all week for this result."(一直在等:现在完成进行)
stage5.stem_cn: 学生们为这个结果等了整整一周。

stage5.stem: "'I ___ this happy before,' Mia said."(从未这么高兴过:现在完成)
"By the time I arrived, the votes had already ___."(此前已被清点完:过去完成被动)
stage5.stem_cn: 我到时,选票已经清点完了。

stage5.stem: "Right now, the principal ___ the winner."(此刻正在宣布:现在进行)
stage5.stem_cn: 此刻,校长正在宣布获胜者。

stage5.stem: "Now Mia ___ all the fun events for this year."(现在正在筹划:现在进行)
stage5.stem_cn: 现在,米娅正在筹划今年所有的趣味活动。

stage5.stem: "Three students are running for club ___."(社长、主席用哪个词)
"After the votes were counted, the ___ was announced."(获胜者用哪个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 选票清点后,宣布了获胜者。

stage5.stem: "The ___ announced the results to the whole school."(校长用哪个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 校长向全校宣布了结果。
